updates.метод: In intact third-instar Drosophila larvae, CsChrimson optogenetically activates cIVda nociceptors while CaMPARI photoconversion in Basin-4 interneurons reports postsynaptic calcium; fluorescence ROIs were defined in Fiji.
updates.датасет: Figure 2E plots per-larva mean delta red/green CaMPARI fluorescence for 8 controls and 9 stimulated larvae; the inspected manuscript/repository item does not supply the underlying per-larva numerical series.
updates.ограничения: The full author manuscript supports a functional cIVda-to-Basin-4 calcium-signaling assay in intact larvae, with Figure 2E reporting 8 control and 9 experimental larvae and a qualitative significant delta(R/G) increase. Exact plotted numerical values, p-value, raw per-larva series, independent replication and a fitted whole-connectome dynamical model are not established here. It does not measure subjective pain, human ECAP, SCS response, or cross-species transfer.

evidence.population: Figure 2E reports 17 third-instar larval observations: 8 no-ATR controls (23 analyzed cells) and 9 stimulated larvae (19 analyzed cells); the plotted unit is each larva averaged over 1-4 cells.
